title: Trump Suspends Diversity Visa Lottery Program, Citing Brown University Gunman
detail: President Trump suspended the Diversity Visa (green card lottery) program, citing its use by the gunman in the Brown University shooting. The executive action halts a program that annually provides up to 55,000 immigrant visas to applicants from countries with historically low immigration rates to the United States.
